fact: The World Bank restructuring paper says MOETE has advanced to pilot the Smart Student digital ID, the pilot to conclude by June 2024, and redefines the result as a smart card operational in one governorate for grades 4 to 11 rather than 1 to 12, because data for grades 1 to 3 students are mostly compiled but cards are not printed for or carried by smaller children; US$25 million of the loan is tied to it.
title: Restructuring Paper on a Proposed Project Restructuring of Supporting Egypt Education Reform Project (Report No: RES57832)
